name: Crumbl Cookies
notes: 2 photos: 1.jpg is an app order-summary/receipt screenshot (skipped, not a menu board); 2.jpg is the in-store digital menu board, used for all dishes. In the Menu column the price column appeared visually offset one row below the item labels (item 'Single' had no price on its own line and one extra price trailed at the bottom); paired items to prices by that one-row offset since it produces realistic Crumbl pricing (Single $5, 4-Pack $16.25, 6-Pack $25, Party Box $42.50, Cream Single $5, Cream Carrier $16.25) rather than the literal same-line pairing.
